verdict.line: You lose if you let him pull you mid-Q-swing and stack his passive for free; you win by poking in short bursts and chaining Q into W before he ever gets to pull, which lines up with the measured 50.4% win rate and Aatrox holding the lane edge.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's Q (The Darkin Blade) locks him into a three-swing animation he can't cancel, and Mordekaiser's E (Death's Grasp) is exactly the kind of hard pull that punishes that commitment. Outside of that specific interaction, Aatrox's Deathbringer Stance autos and W (Infernal Chains) let him win longer trades before Mordekaiser's Darkness Rise passive ever comes online. The 3,147-game sample backs this up as close to even (50.4%) with a slight Aatrox lane edge but no clean kill pressure either way (solo-kill even).

theirWindow.what: Don't commit to your full three-swing Q sequence while his E is available — getting dragged mid-animation lets him land Obliterate for free and advances his Darkness Rise stacks toward the free damage aura.

yourWindow.when: His W (Indestructible) just went on cooldown
yourWindow.what: His stored shield is empty right after he uses it to heal — commit your combo now with Q, autos for Deathbringer Stance procs, and E (Umbral Dash) for the extra heal, since there's no banked shield left to eat the damage.

playing.title: Bait Death's Grasp before all-in
playing.detail: His E (Death's Grasp, cooldown 16/14/12/10/8s) pulls everything in its area and is the exact thing that catches you mid-Q-swing. Make him use it on a dash or poke before you commit your full combo.

playing.title: Trade in short bursts
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after he lands 3 attacks or spells on you, granting him a damage aura and move speed. Land one or two hits and disengage instead of chaining your whole combo so he never completes the stack.

playing.title: Track his W before committing
playing.detail: Indestructible (cooldown 12/11/10/9/8s) banks the damage he deals and takes into a shield he can pop to heal. If he just consumed it, that banked shield is empty — that's your highest-value trade window.

playing.title: Respect level 6 isolation
playing.detail: Realm of Death drags you into a private 1v1 and steals a portion of your stats, on a 140/120/100/90/80s cooldown. Don't get caught overextended near level 6 without your E (Umbral Dash) ready to escape.

playing.title: Use your R to close duels
playing.detail: World Ender fears nearby minions and grants bonus AD, enhanced healing, and move speed, extending the buff on a takedown. Since his own R already isolates you from help, your R is the better tool to actually win the fight it creates.

playing.title: Build into his shield, not around it
playing.detail: Eclipse's burst proc and Sundered Sky's extra on-hit damage are picked specifically to break through a stacked Indestructible shield rather than trade slowly into it.

playing.title: Save Ignite for after his shield pop
playing.detail: Since his sustain comes from a self-shield he has to consume to heal, time Ignite for right after he's already burned Indestructible so he has no answer to the sustained damage.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing calls are this brief's own analysis, not sourced data.
